passive.name: Rough Water
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Break Effect by **60/70/80/90/100%**. The Break DMG dealt by the wearer ignores **20/23/26/29/32%** of the target's DEF. When the wearer's Break Effect in battle is at **150%** or greater, increases their SPD by **12/14/16/18/20%**.

passive.name: Answers of Their Own
passive.text: For each time the wearer hits the same target, DMG dealt increases by **8/10/12/14/16%**, stacking up to **5** time(s). This effect will be dispelled when the wearer changes targets.

passive.name: Chase
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by **8/10/12/14/16%**, and increases their CRIT Rate against enemies with HP percentage **50%** or less by an extra **8/10/12/14/16%**. When the wearer defeats an enemy, their ATK is increased by **20/25/30/35/40%** for **2** turn(s).

passive.name: Record
passive.text: Increases the wearer's ATK by **16/20/24/28/32%**. If there are 2 or fewer enemies on the field, increases wearer's CRIT Rate by **12/15/18/21/24%**.

substatLine: SPD (breakpoint) > BREAK EFFECT% (If Break Build) >= CRIT RATE = CRIT DMG > ATK%

entries.name: Cloudfencer Art: Starshine
entries.text: Deals Physical DMG equal to **100%** of Sushang's ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: Cloudfencer Art: Mountainfall
entries.text:
Deals Physical DMG equal to **210%** of Sushang's ATK to one designated enemy. In addition, there is a **33%** chance to trigger "Sword Stance" on the final hit, dealing Physical Additional DMG equal to **100%** of Sushang's ATK to the enemy.
If the enemy is inflicted with Weakness Break, "Sword Stance" is guaranteed to trigger.

entries.name: Shape of Taixu: Dawn Herald
entries.text:
Deals Physical DMG equal to **320%** of Sushang's ATK to one designated enemy target, and she immediately takes action. In addition, Sushang's ATK increases by **30%** and using her Skill has 2 extra chances to trigger "Sword Stance" for **2** turn(s).
"Sword Stance" triggered from the extra chances deals **50%** of the original DMG.

entries.name: Dancing Blade
entries.text: When an enemy has their Weakness Broken on the field, Sushang's SPD increases by **20%** for **2** turn(s).

entries.name: Cloudfencer Art: Warcry
entries.text: Immediately attacks the enemy. Upon entering battle, Sushang deals Physical DMG equal to **80%** of her ATK to all enemies.

entries.name: Guileless
entries.text: When current HP percentage is **50%** or lower, reduces the chance of being attacked by enemies.

entries.name: Riposte
entries.text: For every Sword Stance triggered, the DMG dealt by Sword Stance increases by **2.5%**. Stacks up to **10** time(s).

entries.name: Vanquisher
entries.text: After using Basic ATK or Skill, if there are enemies on the field that are Weakness Broken, Sushang's action advances by **15%**.

entries.name: Cut With Ease
entries.text: After using Skill against a Weakness Broken enemy, regenerates 1 Skill Point.

entries.name: Refine in Toil
entries.text: After Sword Stance is triggered, the DMG taken by Sushang is reduced by 20% for 1 turn.

entries.name: Rise From Fame
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Prevail via Taixu
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Dwell Like Water
entries.text: Talent's SPD Boost is stackable and can stack up to 2 times. Additionally, after entering battle, Sushang immediately gains 1 stack of her Talent's SPD Boost.
